method: Fresh process/temp home per sample; official DomainFacility + JsonStorageBackend + real openDomainStorage. Cold replay from no checkpoint; incremental reopens after seeding N real events then appending delta. With --steady, independent workers seed one live port, then measure ordinary observe calls, repeated no-new-event flushes, or batches of producer append plus flush. Observation warmup and signed batch generation are outside timing; per-operation CPU/resource/memory sampling is inside the steady aggregate timing. fs wrappers only during the measured workload. JS fs API calls, not kernel syscalls; nested API elapsed times must not be summed. Async open FileHandle stat/read/close/sync/write/writeFile are included. RSS before/after is instantaneous; maxRSS is process lifetime high-water including seed. resourceUsageDelta excludes maxRSS; fsRead/fsWrite count OS blocks, not bytes or guaranteed physical disk I/O. Memory is sampled at operation boundaries, not a phase-local peak. Final byte digests before close; dynamic timestamp/path metadata can differ. A/A = identical root with alternating labels; overhead = unwrapped A vs wrapped B; A/B = roots selected explicitly.
